{{Quote|The dark side has the power to corrupt life itself. Fulminiss is a master at manipulating evolution to create ''unimaginable'' horrors.|Scourge's knowledge of Fulminiss' capabilities|<ref name="Mysterious World" />}}
'''Fulminiss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was regarded as one of the most powerful [[Sith sorcerer]]s in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A master of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side's]] more arcane and lethal aspects, Fulminiss served the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] as one of the Empire's foremost masters in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magic]], and excelled in eliminating the populations of entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. In the early days of the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Emperor sent Lord Fulminiss to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] in order to start his [[Sith Emperor's ritual|life-consuming ritual]] by causing millions of simultaneous [[Death/Legends|deaths]], and the Sith sorcerer enlisted the aid of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Valen-Da]] in his efforts to use a corrupted [[Voss healing ritual|healing ritual]] to drive the planet's inhabitants into murderous insanity. However, Fulminiss was betrayed by Valen-Da, who arranged for the [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Tala-Reh]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] to interrupt Fulminiss's efforts to conduct the ritual with the aid of the dark side entity [[Sel-Makor]], and Fulminiss was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Mission to the Dark Heart (Hero of Tython)|battle]] with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Voss.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I couldn't hear details, but I know someone named Lord Fulminiss went on a secret mission to the planet Voss.''"<br />"''Lord Fulminiss. The Emperor isn't taking any chances with Voss.|[[Jomar Chul]] and Lord Scourge|<ref name="Fallen">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fallen|the Korriban's Flame}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Fulminiss was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who quickly became regarded as one of the greatest [[Sith sorcerer]]s throughout the Empire. During his career before and during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Fulminiss became an expert on mass extermination through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], and the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself requested Fulminiss perform extensive research into eliminating the populations of entire planets. He also conducted extensive experimentation and research in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], creating the grotesque [[Harrower assassin]]s that guarded the [[Emperor's Fortress]], and one of the Sith Lord's most legendary accomplishments was the [[Destruction of a Jabiimi city|disintegration]] of an entire city of rebellious natives on the conquered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] with a raging storm of pure [[Force energy]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lord Fulminiss}}</ref>

Fulminiss's crowning achievement was the creation of the [[Seeds of Rage]], subterranean machines that utilized a combination of low-frequency transmissions and pure [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy to subtly manipulate the emotions and thoughts of all nearby living creatures. The Seeds drove their victims homicidally insane over time, contaminating them with dark side energy and causing corrupted dark growths to form on both the bodies of their victims and the surrounding environment.<ref name="Seeds">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|The Seeds of Rage}}</ref> The Seeds were stored in the ''[[Arcanum]]'', the Emperor's personal storehouse of Sith artifacts, when they were deemed too powerful to be used frequently.<ref name="Invitation">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|An Invitation from Darth Acina|the ''Arcanum''}}</ref> The [[Emperor's Wrath]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the Emperor's personal enforcer, knew of Fulminiss's capabilities,<ref name="Mysterious World" /> and the Sith Lord [[Darth Acina]] considered Fulminiss to be one of the most gifted alchemists of the Empire.<ref name="Invitation" />

[[File:Fulminiss_and_Valen-Da.png|thumb|left|220px|Fulminiss and Valen-Da]]
Around [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the Republic, Fulminiss was dispatched by the Emperor himself to the planet [[Voss]], where Fulminiss was ordered to use his knowledge and expertise to bring about millions of simultaneous [[Death/Legends|deaths]] among the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. With a number of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]], Fulminiss established a [[Fulminiss's base|base]] in the [[Old Paths]] region of the world. While preparing for to test rituals of Sith magic on Voss subjects, Fulminiss was approached by the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Valen-Da]],<ref name="Mysterious World" /> who had [[Force vision/Legends|foreseen]] that Fulminiss would, with the help of the dark side entity known as [[Sel-Makor]], try to destroy all of Voss; but Valen-Da had also foreseen the means to stop Fulminiss and Sel-Makor,<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" /> so the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Mystic joined Fulminiss and offered to grant him access to the Voss [[Shrine of Healing]] so that he could learn a [[Voss healing ritual]] that could heal damaged bodies and minds.<ref name="Bloody Pilgrimage">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Bloody Pilgrimage|Voss}}</ref> The two returned to Fulminiss's base, where Fulminiss tested his abilities on the apprentices and drove them insane, eliminating the loose end they posed in the process.<ref name="Mysterious World" />

The two then traveled to the Shrine of Healing, where Fulminiss learned the healing ritual from the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of the long-dead Mystics [[Laeras-Wu]], [[Shanatka-Lo]], and [[Hanar-Ye]], but the Sith Lord corrupted the ritual so that it would tear apart the minds of its victims and drive them insane. With the power of the ritual, Fulminiss was then able to affect many more victims from a greater distance than before, but it was not enough to complete his mission, and he departed the Shrine with Valen-Da at his side.<ref name="Bloody Pilgrimage" /> By that time, Fulminiss had become aware of the existence of Sel-Makor, which was a powerful dark side entity that was located at the center of the region known as the [[Nightmare Lands]]. Over three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after they had departed the Shrine, Fulminiss and Valen-Da arrived at the [[Dark Heart]], the seat of Sel-Makor's power, and Fulminiss conversed with Sel-Makor and explained his plans. Sel-Makor was more than willing to aid in the destruction of the Voss and the Gormak and agreed to lend Fulminiss its power, and Fulminiss began his preparations.<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" />

[[File:Battle_in_the_Dark_Heart.png|thumb|right|170px|Fulminiss battles the Knight and Tala-Reh.]]
However, Fulminiss was surprised by the arrival of the [[Hero of Tython]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had escaped from the Emperor's thrall recently and was working to halt the Emperor's agents, one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] companions, and the [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Tala-Reh]], all of whom had been following Valen-Da's trail. Enraged by Valen-Da's betrayal, as the Mystic had left a message to Tala-Reh to lead his pursuers to the Dark Heart, Fulminiss drew his lightsaber and attacked the intruders, his strength bolstered by Sel-Makor. Fulminiss's enhanced strength ultimately was not enough to overcome his three opponents, and the Sith Lord fell in [[Mission to the Dark Heart (Hero of Tython)|battle]], his mission for the Emperor unfinished.<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" /> His death and the loss of his expertise in the dark side was mourned by a number of Sith Lords, including Darth Acina.<ref name="Invitation" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Fulminiss often pleased the Emperor with his ruthless cruelty.|Lord Scourge|<ref name="Mysterious World" />}}
Fulminiss was a powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Human with [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants underneath his eyes, and a skin that had a sickly grey pallor. He wore gray and red hooded robes with black and purple markings, and Fulminiss was a cruel individual who took pleasure in dealing death on a massive scale. The Sith Lord was considered an enigmatic genius by many of his contemporaries, and he was more than willing to put his knowledge and talents to use in the extermination of entire species without any regret or objections. Fulminiss paid little attention to Valen-Da during his mission to Voss, allowing the Mystic to leave clues and messages for Tala-Reh and the Hero of Tython so that they could pursue the Sith Lord.<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Lord Fulminiss created the Harrowers you faced in the Emperor's fortress&mdash;be wary.''"<br />"''The Harrowers were twisted beings of pure evil.|Lord Scourge and the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Mysterious World" />}}
A greatly respected Sith sorcerer with decades of experience, Fulminiss was a master of both Sith magic and alchemy. His knowledge of the dark side and the fields of Sith magic and alchemy in particular were unrivaled; the Emperor himself requested Fulminiss's talents more than once, and members of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] often paid great sums to acquire Fulminiss's research notes and reports of his work for their own studies.<ref name="Codex" /> In battle, Fulminiss wielded a purple [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and he used the Force to [[Mind trick/Legends#Force fear|overwhelm]] his opponents with nightmares and fear.<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" /> A highly skilled Sith sorcerer, Fulminiss also experimented in merging technology with Sith alchemy, using the resultant combinations to drive creatures and beings insane or altering their physical form,<ref name="Seeds" /> and he considered the Harrower assassins to be his favorite creation. Fulminiss was also capable of summoning storms of pure Force energy; such storms could annihilate entire cities with their destructive power.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fulminiss was first introduced in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is a primary antagonist in the Jedi Knight class storyline on Voss.<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" /> It is never made entirely clear how Fulminiss becomes aware of Sel-Makor; the Emperor encountered Sel-Makor shortly before sending Fulminiss to Voss, but it is not explained whether Fulminiss learned about the entity from the Emperor, Valen-Da, or another source.<ref name="The Voice of Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}}</ref> Fulminiss is also mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the [[2013]] Digital Expansion to ''The Old Republic'', as the creator of the Seeds of Rage. Fulminiss's death is also mentioned by the Sith Lord Darth Acina, and the Seeds are the subject of the [[Seeker Droid|seeker droid]] missions for both the Republic and the Empire.<ref name="Invitation" />
